rule: Secure correct space before publicising the event.
Requests less than two weeks in advance may be difficult for service teams.
Catering orders should be placed 30 days before the event and final numbers confirmed 5 days before.
Additional security is required for larger events of 100+; inform security no later than 3 weeks before.
Higher risk events with 50+ people and alcohol need number-management procedure agreed with Head of Security.
